race.comment: JEWEL OF ZAVALA (9) was too good last start when running over the top to score by a head at this track and trip. The form out of that has worked out well and she maps for a slightly better run this time. Can keep the ball rolling. YAPPER (3) felt the pinch first-up without a trial but should be much better for that outing. He gets the blinkers on this time and has been given some time to get over the fresh effort. Still lightly raced and can run a cheeky race. GIRLS ON FIRE (2) comes back in distance today after fading badly over further most recently. Atherden's 3kg claim is a big tick and back to the sprinting trip is a bonus. A host of gear changes can see her run a better race. SATIN BOW (10) can run a better race today. VIOLENT (12) can feature on resumption.
